title: FAI Plugin Provides MCP v1
description: Validates the `providesMcp` field on `plugin.json`. Declares that a plugin ships an external MCP server with it. Read by the FrootAI marketplace (for the federation-ready badge) and the auto-discovery flow (registers the plugin's server in the federated areas catalog on install).
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [M0.5] of the FAI MCP Federation Kernel masterplan. Doctrine principle 3 — NO HARD-CODED PUBLISHER LIST: a plugin can declare a tier-1/2/3 server, but the trust verdict is always evaluated against the shipped trust.json + user overrides — never trusted just because the plugin says so.

name.description: Kebab-case slug for the area name. Becomes the prefix in `<area>.<tool>`.

transport.description: Wire protocol the bundled server speaks. `stdio` is the most common (spawned as subprocess). `http-*` requires a URL spec in the plugin's install hook.

trust.description: Trust tier the plugin author CLAIMS. The kernel re-evaluates against the shipped trust manifest — `untrusted` is always blocked regardless of claim.

publisher.description: GitHub-org-style publisher slug (e.g. `microsoft`, `upstash`, `notion`). Optional; if absent, defaults to the plugin's `author.name` (lowercased + kebab-cased).

command.description: For `transport: stdio` — the executable command (e.g. `npx`, `node`, `python`). Required when transport is stdio.

args.description: For `transport: stdio` — args passed to the command (e.g. `['-y', '@azure/mcp', 'server', 'start']`).

url.description: For `transport: http-sse` or `http-streaming` — the endpoint URL. Required when transport is http-*.
